note: Alberta Parks campground in Castle Provincial Park, 20 km west of Pincher Creek on Hwy 507, then 16 km south on Hwy 774 and 1 km west. One loop in a spruce stand on the inside of a bend of the Castle River, below the far bank's eroded cliffs; the comfort-camping cabins are sites 5, 12, 20, 23 and 26. No firewood sold. --Claude
summary: Read the Alberta Parks page (updated Oct 28, 2026), the shop site list and the tear sheet: 23 power (15/30 A) sites C$34, 41-100 ft, 9 pull-through, vault toilets, standpipe water, reservable 90 days ahead; season May 14 - Sep 30 (derived approximate -> exact). Phone 403-627-1165 suggested. Stored riverfront NOT supported: recommend not waterfront. Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (stored riverfront, evidence 'NE loop-edge sites hug the inside bend of the Castle River within ~15-25m behind only a thin riparian tree fringe'): recommend NOT WATERFRONT. (1) The shop tags every one of the 23 power sites 'Near Water - no' (the same shop tags Beaver Mines C52-C58 and Syncline B 'Near Water - yes'). (2) On Esri imagery (0.33 m/px crop) the river-side spurs of the loop (tear-sheet sites 27-30, 2, 4) sit 30-50 m from the river's edge with a continuous band of mature spruce between; no open apron, no gravel-bar pad. (3) Site photos of A28 and A30, two of the river-side sites, show only forest around the pads; A28's frames glimpse the far bank's eroded cliff through the trees but no water. The page's 'Sites ... are located along the river' is marketing-level and the evidence's 15-25 m thin-fringe reading is not what the imagery shows. Not even a view to claim, so not waterfront rather than riverview.
PIN (49.40220,-114.33950): in the open meadow inside the loop, ~160 m WSW of the page's directions point 49.402558,-114.33737. Within tolerance; no move.

ADVISORY on the page is for Designated Camping Area 3B (Wolfberry) in the same park, partial closure May 1 - Nov 30, 2026: not this campground. Shop current status 'Seasonal Closure' (normal off-season).
